Old Bridge Municipal Court

Address: 1 Old Bridge Plaza, Old Bridge, NJ 08857, United States

Phone: 732-721-5600

Old Bridge Municipal Court, also known as old bridge township court, is a city court house in the old bridges township municipal complex. The court has jurisdiction over misdemeanor cases of traffic violations, criminal matters, and local ordinance violations. If any severe cases come in this court, then that case is transferred to the Middlesex County Prosecutor’s Office in New Brunswick.

How to find records?

Old Bridge Municipal Court records lookup can be found in the following ways:

  • Searching by name
  • Searching by case number
  • Searching by address
  • Searching by phone
  • Searching by email

Some recorded information is confidential and is not found online. For these types of records, a person had to submit an open record request to the clerk's office. Download and fill in all the information on the form and send it to the court clerk's office. The court will then decide whether to provide you with that record information or not.

see also Travis County District Clerk Office

Division:

Old Bridge Municipal Court consist of two division that are:

  • Criminal Division
  • Traffic Division

How to make payments?

Old Bridge Municipal Court payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the counter. Service or deduction charges of 2.99% will be applied if you pay with a credit card.

Online

A person can pay online by using the online payment website. Personal information, Total acceptable amount, Vehicle, or other information must be filled in the online payment method. Processing fees will be applied in this method.

Link: https://njmcdirect.page/

Mail

A Person can send a certified check or money order to the court's mailing address. Do not send cash or personal statements in the mail; only accredited checks are accepted. The mailing address is 1 Old Bridge Plaza, Old Bridge, NJ 08857, United States.

The criminal division handles which types of cases?

Old Bridge Municipal Court criminal division handles cases of criminal offences. These offences include bar fights, theft, terrorism threats, harassment, drinking at an immature age or publically, trespass, Drug Paraphernalia proprietorship, and behaving mischievously with others. If you are involved in any criminal cases, hire a professional criminal attorney for the case guidance. The attorney will guide you and help you with the issue.

see also Birmingham Municipal Court

The Traffic division handles which types of cases?

Old Bridge Municipal Court traffic division handles cases of traffic offences. These offences include driving while drinking, following someone very closely, driving carelessly, recklessly, or fast, not obeying traffic signals or traffic lanes, leaving the site of the accident, driving without a license, expired or suspended license, tailgating and taking improper right or left turns. If you received a traffic ticket, enter a guilty or not guilty plea and send it to the court. The court will reply whether you had to appear in court or only pay the fine, and the case is solved; If you are involved in any traffic cases, then hire a professional traffic attorney for the case guidance. The attorney will guide you and help you with the issue. If a person does not pay a fine on time, their license or insurance will be suspended.

Which violation comes under the local ordinance?

Old Bridge Municipal Court's local ordinance violation consists of the followings:

  • Infraction of the leash law
  • Code Violation of building
  • Violation of noise
  • Nuisance maintains

Whenever a person has done this type of violation, a case has occurred against them, and they have to pay fines if they do not want to lose their insurance and license.

How to get a marriage license?

Old Bridge Municipal Court marriage license is obtained from the clerk's office and is given by the health department of North Brunswick, NJ. The fee for a marriage license is $28 and for certificates is $10 per copy. The couple's age must be 18+. To obtain the permit, the couple had to submit a marriage form with a birth certificate, photo ID like a driver’s license, passport, or anything that could prove their identity, and two witnesses will be mandatory. If anyone is divorced, a divorce paper must be submitted before getting support. If anyone wants the copies, fill out the certificated copy of the marriage license request, and submit it to the court. The certification is valid for up to 30 days; after receiving it, a marriage ceremony will be held in court. When receiving the certificate, you had to tell the name of the person who will do your marriage ceremony.

What are the responsibilities of a clerk?

Old Bridge Municipal Court clerk is responsible for giving the permits, certificates of birth, death, and marriage, collecting fines, solving residents' queries, and helping judges in performing their duties. The clerk's office is an agent of licensing and custodians of the town records.

FAQ:

Which proof of identity documents are required for a marriage certificate?

The proof of identity documents required for the marriage license is:

  • Driver’s License
  • Passport
  • Military ID
  • Employee’s Photo ID
  • Non-Driving License

Who can be my wedding officiant?

Your wedding officiants will be any judge of municipal, superior, tax, and district court, mayor, chairman of any committee, and New Jersey village president. You can choose any one of these to be your marriage ceremony officiant.

How can I contact the clerk?

You can visit the clerk's office during business hours or call the clerk's office for any information or guidance.

Phone: 732-721-5600

What is the court code?

Old Bridge Municipal Court code is 1209.

How can I pay for my traffic ticket?

Old Bridge Municipal Court Traffic Ticket can be paid online, by mail, or by visiting the court during working hours.

Which clothes are allowed in the court?

Clothes should be comfortable, simple, and respectable. A suit or a pent coat are recommended. Sleeveless, tight shirts, and torn pants are not allowed on the court.
